name: Electrical strike and rooted fire
notes: The lightning arrival is 0.23 s, so fire preparation starts at 0.23 s. Fire release follows its own 0.28 s preparation, at 0.51 s. The fire source (0,12) is translated by y=-12 to the strike point (0,0). Sparks are hidden in the fire cue so lightning branches and fire volumes retain separate roles; this is an existing diagnostic layer option, not a new particle budget. Functional composition example; native/full-speed art review is not implied.
